British analysts deciphered Germany’s proposal to Mexico involving unrestricted submarine warfare and the recovery of lost US territory; its publication caused a sensation and helped propel the United States into the First World War against Germany.

When it became public, the Zimmerman Telegram caused a sensation, helping propel the US into the conflict against Germany.

stories.summary: President Donald Trump has backed Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, saying the United States has no evidence of wrongdoing. Trump cited the US attorney general in defending Huang while urging Nvidia to continue its investigation into export controls.
